description: Solar Resource Areas (2022) is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. Solar Resource Areas created were produced using a k-means method that groups solar generating plants into discrete regions based on their latitude, longitude, and distance to the coast. After facilities were grouped, the outermost facilities in each region were connected to create the boundaries for each region. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are CAOpenData, California Energy Commission, California Natural Resources Agency, EAD, california energy commission. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
